# S Vijay Krishnan

> S Vijay Krishnan is an award-winning Tamil film director and producer based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, and the founder of VK Productions. This is his official website.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://vijaykrishnan.in/): Overview, featured films and showreel
- [About](https://vijaykrishnan.in/about): Biography, career timeline and directing philosophy
- [Filmography](https://vijaykrishnan.in/filmography): All films directed and produced
- [Production](https://vijaykrishnan.in/production): VK Productions services
- [Creative Vision](https://vijaykrishnan.in/creative-vision): Filmmaking philosophy and visual principles
- [Gallery](https://vijaykrishnan.in/gallery): On-set photography and film stills
- [Press & Awards](https://vijaykrishnan.in/press-awards): Festival awards and press coverage
- [Contact](https://vijaykrishnan.in/contact): Collaboration and press enquiries
